title: docs(qa): qa-media-constraints and qa-feeds-disabled declare namespaces their object names carry
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8947HaMXTZWUhakq787UCbL)_
Fixes #26876

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:两个 QA 配方的第 1 步安装清单各自声明命名空间(`qa-media-constraints` → `qamedia`,`qa-feeds-disabled` → `qafeeds`),对象随之改名 `qa_media` → `qamedia_media`、`qa_nofeeds` → `qafeeds_nofeeds`;用到它们的两个条目 revision 各升一级(6、9)并加一行 history。
- 为什么改:照原文重放,安装从包 id 推出命名空间 `media` / `feeds`,第 2 步建对象 422 NAMESPACE_PREFIX,条目只能记 blocked(fixture)。不能也声明 `qa`:`qa` 已归 `qa-scratch-authz` 的包所有,同机第二个 `qa` 包实测 422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT。
- 风险与回滚:只改 QA 台账两个 JSON 文件,不动产品代码;只换对象名,子句断言、步骤顺序和 oracle 不变;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:两个文件顶部配方的 step 1 与 provenance,再看两个条目 history 的最新一行。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`,预期 OK。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `areas/attachments-storage.json`, recipe `qa-media-constraints`: step 1 declares `manifest.namespace: "qamedia"`; step 2 saves `qamedia_media`. Step 1's `expect` says why the namespace is declared, why it is not `qa`, and that the three QA packages (`qa`, `qamedia`, `qafeeds`) co-install on one boot as a supported run shape; its `source` cites the derivation, the prefix judge and `NamespaceConflictError`. `provenance` records the replay below. The stale knownGap "this recipe has NOT yet been proven by a live run" now points at the two live proofs (QA run #24560 and this replay).
- `areas/records-forms.json`, recipe `qa-feeds-disabled`: the same change with `qafeeds` / `qafeeds_nofeeds`, including `provenance`.
- Opting-in items, revision +1 and a `history` row citing #26876 each:
  - `attachments-storage.field-accept-maxsize-server-enforced` (5 → 6): `qa_media` → `qamedia_media` in fixtures.requires[0], provisioning.why, steps, acceptance and negative.
  - `records-forms.record-discussion-mentions` (8 → 9): `qa_nofeeds` → `qafeeds_nofeeds` in steps[8], steps[9], acceptance[5], acceptance[6].verify and negative[2], the `thread_id` spelling `'qafeeds_nofeeds:<id>'` included.
- History rows that already named the old objects are left as written.

## Why

The only namespace `qa_media` and `qa_nofeeds` already carry is `qa`, and PR #26875 gave `qa` to `com.objectstack.qa.attachments`. A namespace has one owner per boot, so a rename was the only fix that keeps all three recipes installable together. Each recipe now declares a namespace instead of relying on the id-derived default, and the object keeps its old stem after the new prefix (`qa_X` → `qaNS_X`), following the `qasub` precedent in `areas/automation.json`. The package ids are unchanged, so each teardown `DELETE` still names the same package.

### Recipe sweep (triage 6452130965)

Every area recipe in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json` was read for the same shape: a step-1 manifest with no namespace whose objects carry another prefix. 8 recipes:

| recipe | installs a package | result |
|---|---|---|
| attachments `qa-scratch-authz` | yes, declares `qa` | cleared (#26875); replayed steps 1–4 here, 201/200/200/200 |
| attachments `qa-media-constraints` | yes, no namespace | **fixed here** |
| records-forms `qa-feeds-disabled` | yes, no namespace | **fixed here** |
| automation `qa-flow-status-doors` | yes, derived `automation` | cleared: it saves flows, and the prefix judge asks only `object` saves (`protocol.ts`, `singularType === 'object'`); replayed steps 1–3 on the same boot, 201/200/200 |
| automation `qa-second-packaged-caller` | yes, declares `qasub`, flow `qasub_*` | cleared by reading (not replayed: install-local writes into the project tree) |
| approvals `qa-cross-org-request` | no | cleared |
| cli `cli-18-prerelease-db` | no | cleared |
| search `qa-contributor-bound-member` | no | cleared |

## Verification

No code changed. Both recipes were replayed REST only on one fresh stock showcase boot built from main a51ba639 (full `turbo run build`, then `pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 4876`, no env posture). The script read each recipe's JSON from the file and sent it literally: the "before" leg from origin/main's text, the "after" leg from this branch.

<details><summary>Replay transcript</summary>

```text
== A. AS WRITTEN (origin/main text) ==
[old qa-media-constraints] step 1 POST /api/v1/packages -> 201   manifest.namespace "media"
[old qa-media-constraints] step 2 PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qa_media?package=com.objectstack.qa.media -> 422 NAMESPACE_PREFIX Object 'qa_media' is missing the package namespace prefix. Rename it to 'media_qa_media' (namespace = 'media').
[old qa-media-constraints] teardown DELETE /api/v1/packages/com.objectstack.qa.media -> 200
[old qa-feeds-disabled] step 1 POST /api/v1/packages -> 201   manifest.namespace "feeds"
[old qa-feeds-disabled] step 2 PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qa_nofeeds?package=com.objectstack.qa.feeds -> 422 NAMESPACE_PREFIX Object 'qa_nofeeds' is missing the package namespace prefix. Rename it to 'feeds_qa_nofeeds' (namespace = 'feeds').
[old qa-feeds-disabled] teardown DELETE /api/v1/packages/com.objectstack.qa.feeds -> 200

== B. FIXED, all co-installed on one boot ==
[qa-scratch-authz] step 1 POST /api/v1/packages -> 201   manifest.namespace "qa"
[qa-scratch-authz] step 2-4 PUT qa_vault / qa_shared / qa_nofiles -> 200 each
[qa-media-constraints] step 1 POST /api/v1/packages -> 201   manifest.namespace "qamedia"
[qa-media-constraints] step 2 PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qamedia_media?package=com.objectstack.qa.media -> 200  Saved object 'qamedia_media' (state=active)
[qa-feeds-disabled] step 1 POST /api/v1/packages -> 201   manifest.namespace "qafeeds"
[qa-feeds-disabled] step 2 PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qafeeds_nofeeds?package=com.objectstack.qa.feeds -> 200  Saved object 'qafeeds_nofeeds' (state=active)
[qa-flow-status-doors] step 1 POST /api/v1/packages -> 201   manifest.namespace "automation"
[qa-flow-status-doors] step 2-3 PUT flow qa_no_start_node / qa_always_fails -> 200 each

== C. the constraint: a second package declaring qa ==
POST /api/v1/packages {id com.objectstack.qa.nsprobe, namespace qa} -> 422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT Namespace conflict: namespace "qa" is already owned by package "com.objectstack.qa.attachments" …

== D. the fixtures do their job ==
GET meta/object/qamedia_media -> poster {"type":"image","accept":["image/png","image/jpeg"],"maxSize":1048576} doc {"type":"file","accept":[".pdf"]}
POST data/qafeeds_nofeeds {name:'qa-nofeeds-probe'} -> 201
POST data/sys_comment {thread_id:'qafeeds_nofeeds:<id>'} -> 403 FEEDS_DISABLED Comments are disabled for object 'qafeeds_nofeeds' (enable.feeds: false)

== E. teardown ==
DELETE /api/v1/packages/com.objectstack.qa.media | .feeds | .attachments | .automation -> 200 each
GET meta/object/qamedia_media | qafeeds_nofeeds -> 404 each
```

</details>

Local gates on head 40d6c4fa (main c4a4aefc), derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 16 families, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciles 16 derived, 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `check:platform-checklist` prints `OK — 16 areas, 329 items … provisioning: 8 area recipes, 13 item references resolved … 8/8 recipes referenced`.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, reported to the seat: item `records-forms.field-group-visible-when` authors `qa_group_gate` inline ("install a scratch package, then PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qa_group_gate?package=<id>", reusing this recipe's pattern) with no namespace named. Under any scratch id other than one ending in `qa` it meets the same 422, and declaring `qa` collides with `qa-scratch-authz`. It is an item step, not an area recipe, so the sweep did not touch it.
- `packages/rest/src/rest-declared-client-refusal-log.test.ts` still mocks an object named `qa_media`. It is a unit-test stand-in that never reads this recipe, so it is left alone.
- ⚠️ The #26573 thread also edits `records-forms.json` (other items). Whichever PR lands second merges `origin/main` and re-runs `check-platform-checklist`.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (no linted file touched)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
